summary: Frontend-focused testing of the rebuilt YOUR NEXT WATCH section (curved continuous 35mm film band) on https://mind-without-genre--9d6g62yr.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified reel geometry (40 slices x 2 reels = 80 slice elements, 8 ynw-frame groups, 8 ynw-frame-probe origin rects, 80 ynw-slice-window and 80 ynw-slice-shade overlays), arrow rotation (counter advances 01/04 THE BUILDS -> 02/04 REVIFY), drag fling with momentum (fling carried reel 01 -> 04 RAG ASSISTANT with correct front-frame content), sound chip toggling (data-testid='ynw-sound-toggle' flips 'Sound On' <-> 'Sound Off', persisted in localStorage key 'ynw-sound' as 'off'/'on' across reloads), expansion portal (centre-third click opens .ynw-detail-container with correct THE BUILDS collection content including Chapter chip, three BUILD cards for REVIFY/EMFLOW/RAG ASSISTANT, Back to Watchlist + ESC chip + Next Build: REVIFY CTA), ESC closes portal cleanly, mobile 390x844 renders curved band readably with crimson period and visible SOUND ON chip, no horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile, resize from 1920 -> 1200 -> 390 rebuilt reels without breakage (slice/frame counts preserved), and regression on THE TOOLKIT, THE FILMOGRAPHY, OFF-SCRIPT, contact footer all still render. No pageerrors and no console errors observed across load, spinning, fling, expansion, ESC close, resize, and sound toggle flows.
critical_code_review_comments: filmEngine.js is a large module - consider splitting physics loop (settle/coast/startLoop) from DOM build (measure/buildBand/updateShading) for maintainability, but current structure is functional.

Keyboard ArrowRight on the page did not advance the reel when focus was on body (counter stayed at 01) - works via arrow buttons/dots/wheel/drag; main agent may want to confirm keyboard rotation requires focus on the reel container (likely intentional per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: YNW section uses .ynw-reel container with child .ynw-viewport > .ynw-scene > .ynw-frame (each containing .ynw-frame-probe and multiple .ynw-slice/.ynw-slice-window/.ynw-slice-shade). Counter selector: [class*=ynw-counter]. Sound toggle: [data-testid='ynw-sound-toggle']. Detail portal: [class*=ynw-detail] (ynw-detail-container when open). Centre-third click on reel expands the active frame. Dots: .ynw-dots button. Arrows: .ynw-arrows button. The 'Professional' profile card (3rd) and the first profile card both route to a page containing YNW. ESC closes the detail portal. No console errors in any flow.
